summary.text: Dave Murphy is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Assembly representing District 56, based in Hortonville, and has been elected to the Assembly since 2012.
He chairs the Committee on Colleges and Universities and is vice-chair of the Committee on Housing and Real Estate.

paragraphs.text: Murphy was born in Appleton, Wisconsin, on November 26, 1954, and is married with two children.
He graduated from Hortonville High School in 1972, attended the University of Wisconsin-Fox Valley from 1972 to 1974, and studied at the Wisconsin School of Real Estate in 1975.
Before serving full time in the Legislature, he was the owner of a fitness center and an agribusiness and worked as a real estate broker.

His listed memberships include the board of directors of Irish Fest of the Fox Cities, the advisory board of Wisconsin Family Impact Seminars, the board of Free Speech For Campus, the Greenville Lions Club and Immanuel Lutheran Church.
He is also a member of the Midwestern Higher Education Commission and the Wisconsin-Ireland Trade Commission.
